sentiment.rationale: The document shows strong operational momentum: revenue up 11% YoY, EPS up 31% YoY, and net income up 23% YoY. Management explicitly guided 4Q25 NII (FTE) to $15.6B-$15.7B, up ~8% vs. 4Q24, which is a meaningful forward guidance raise. The CEO and CFO used confident language ('strong net income growth', 'earnings power of our diversified model'). No material risks or headwinds were raised in the forward outlook. The score is capped at +0.30 because the guidance raise is for one quarter only and is partially attributed to fixed-rate asset repricing and Global Markets activity, not purely organic core banking momentum.
